Author: fruitipebbles
Description:
[font=Courier New][img]https://imgur.com/ud17Ply.png[/img]

[font=Courier New][color=#e06666][size=5]NOTE: This mod DOES NOT include the sleeves.[/size][size=5] [/size][/color]

I wasn't going to make another clothing mod, but you see, "colorable hats" kind of forced my hand...[/font][/i][font=Courier New] [/font][/b][font=Courier New]

Rural Outfitters adds brand new color customizable clothing items via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]! With seven new shirts, three  skirts, five hats, four accessories, and five makeup options, the options are quite literally unlimited!

Accessories with Fashion Sense are stackable! Wear blush, heterochromia, and earrings all at the same time! Or check out other Fashion Sense packs (they're all super compatible!)

[spoiler][/font]
[font=Courier New][b]installation:[/b]

Requires: SMAPI & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]. Non-negotiable.
Stick it in your mods folder! That's it!
[/font][font=Courier New]

Beanie

[/font][font=Courier New]
